findings.title: Database migrations run when the application starts
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz does not run a migration step of its own for this app — the running application updates its own database schema on boot.
findings.suggestedOutcome: No action needed — migrations run on application startup and Deployz monitors the app until it reports healthy.
findings.technicalEvidence: Migrations run at startup: migration runner call (server/index.ts).
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app applies its database migrations when the application itself starts, not as a separate deploy step.

findings.title: Background worker process
findings.whyItMatters: The worker starts with its own command, so background jobs keep running even when no web request comes in.
findings.suggestedOutcome: No change needed — Deployz will start the worker process alongside your app.
findings.technicalEvidence: Worker patterns detected: bull, declared worker process (Procfile)
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app declares a background worker process. Deployz runs it as a second container next to the web process.
